description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Pinnacle Monk, adding one mana of any color.
When Pinnacle Monk dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Pinnacle Monk from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Pinnacle Monk from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.
